question: In a certain code language, 'PIGEON' is written as ‘OPFHJQ’ and 'TURKEY' is written as ‘ZFLSVU’.How will 'PARROT' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

 'PIGEON' is written as ‘OPFHJQ’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f0fd5331766db7ba5b9cc79e712f69e62abf05abcc38d1600be00cce02bd865.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/009cee9fd6dda130ff52ae62b12708ac49dd735fda023c2eb7ff3ad6f0a87b0b.png] 

And,

 'TURKEY' is written as ‘ZFLSVU’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/46b25b303c57693e9e40a39bb4cb638a20088995a9ac45da84976782fb942703.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/656c3885304335e7ac67220c316a4fdd1eb9c7d23aa93124acb4d2665cfaf0d3.png] 

Similarly,

'PARROT' is written as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7035a65bed549be9a831402ce6b412f50d01d2d0e2b9444ecb748c3c7f4b8dfd.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a652c23ef90028e1d49f1dc3e52f15f64148ec3f4a4170403e308e3834d124e9.png] 

Thus, 'PARROT' is written as 'UPSSBQ'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
